title: [finding] release.yml: the publishing run's Docker job installs @objectstack/cli about a minute after `changeset publish`, before npm serves the fixed group's tarballs, so the image build 404s (18.1.0: spec-18.1.0.tgz)
body:
Filing gate: ① a real, reproduced failure in a release lane (run 40078805767, job 120834761830) ② no open or closed card covers it ③ the fix sits in one workflow file
Reader: CI/release lane, `.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml` (or the `docker` job in `.github/workflows/release.yml`); next PR adds the wait
Dedupe (open AND closed): "Docker image build fails E404 npm tarball not yet propagated right after publish" → 6 hits. None covers this: #20627 (closed) is a *later landing's* backfill starting mid-publish; #23801 (closed) is an npm peer-resolution crash; #4900 (closed) is the Release body size.
reach: release lane only, measured on the 18.1.0 publish 2026-10-24
QA-source: 18.1.0 re-cut thread, release run 40078805767 · Docker image · Build and push
Checklist item priority: P2 (npm publish is unaffected; the image self-heals on the next main landing or a re-run)
type: Bug

## What happened

Release run [40078805767](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40078805767) on version commit e649c2d91 (#25606):

- `Publish 18.1.0 to npm`: success. The GitHub Release was created at 09:13:33Z.
- `Docker image / Build & push`: failure at `Build and push`, Dockerfile:88 (`npm install -g @objectstack/cli@18.1.0 …`), at 09:14:47Z:

```
npm error code E404
npm error 404 Not Found - GET https://registry.npmjs.org/@objectstack/spec/-/spec-18.1.0.tgz - Not found
```

A few minutes later the same URL returns 200 and `npm view @objectstack/spec@18.1.0` resolves. So the failure is registry/CDN propagation lag between `changeset publish` returning and every tarball of the fixed group being downloadable.

## Why it is not covered today

`docker` needs `publish`, and `docker-publish.yml` goes straight from `Validate version input` (a semver regex) to `Build and push`. Nothing waits until npm actually serves the cli's dependency tarballs. release-integrity's group probe guards a *later* landing (#20627), not the publishing run's own image build.

## Proposed fix

Add a step to `docker-publish.yml` before `Build and push`: for each package of the fixed group that `@objectstack/cli@<version>` depends on (or just the whole fixed group), poll the tarball URL from `npm view <pkg>@<version> dist.tarball` until it returns 200. Use a bounded wait (for example up to 10 min with backoff), then fail with a message that names the missing package. On a `workflow_dispatch` rebuild of an old version the step passes at once.

## Recovery for 18.1.0

`ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/objectstack:18.1.0` is not pushed yet. Either "Re-run failed jobs" on run 40078805767 (maintainer), or the next main landing's release-integrity backfill requests the image.
